title: Improve data-items detector recall (38/140 -> 60+)
description: Data items recall is 43/140 (30.7%) on develop; baseline was 38/140 (27.1%). The +5 came from Ruby ingestion side effects, not data-items detector work. Target the data-items detector to improve recall toward 60+/140 without cratering precision, other layers unchanged. Investigate why the data-items detector misses ~97 of 140 gold positives. Do not change gold. Measure against pinned baseline.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Plan approved. Worktree verified at /tmp/scanner-data-items on cursor/improve-data-items @ 86873e5 (= origin/develop). Implementation authorized. Root cause: 57 collision misses (rollup, not pattern-fixable) + 27 pattern gaps (compound tokens). Phase 1: token-aware alias matching (Approach A, reuses EVIDENCE_ALIAS_TO_RULE) to catch the 27 pattern misses -> ~70/140. Do NOT change rollup in Phase 1 (precision would crater). Precision gate: scoped >= 30%. No gold/eval/other-detector changes. Target: data-items 43/140 -> 60+, other layers unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Round wind-down: Phase 1 merged via PR #71.

Scorecard (vs pinned baseline 6d241f8):
- mentions: 33/79 → 62/79 (+29, side effect of alias matching)
- data-items: 38/140 → 43/140 (unchanged this PR; rollup collisions block further gains)
- components: 3/519 → 136/519 (prior slices)
- data-flows: 0/158 → 20/158 (prior slices)

Phase 1 target (60+ data-items recall) NOT met. Root cause confirmed: repo-wide rollup + assignOneToOne collision blocking (~57 misses). Phase 2 (rollup refactor) required for data-items target.

Closing Phase 1 task. Phase 2 should be a new task under the epic.

right_now_summary: Phase 1 is merged, but recall remains 43/140; Phase 2 must address rollup collisions to reach 60+.
